title: Platform Connectivity Failures
summary: The CLI or SDK cannot reach the qym platform or fails auth checks.
symptoms: Run streaming or `qym run list` returns authentication or network errors.
checks: Verify `QYM_PLATFORM_URL` points to the deployed platform URL, including any root-path prefix.
Verify `QYM_API_KEY` is present and still valid for the target user or project.
If the deployment sits behind a proxy, verify the platform `QYM_BASE_URL` and `QYM_ROOT_PATH` match the exposed route.
fixes: Correct the platform URL or API key and rerun `qym config check`.
If the platform is intentionally unreachable, switch to an offline workflow and upload artifacts later.

title: Judge Metrics Not Working
summary: Judge-based metrics fail because the model or provider credentials are not configured correctly.
symptoms: Runs fail only when judge metrics are enabled.
Judge metrics return provider or auth errors.
checks: Verify `QYM_JUDGE_API_KEY` or a compatible alias is present.
If using a self-hosted provider, verify `QYM_JUDGE_BASE_URL` points at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
fixes: Validate the provider independently before rerunning the full evaluation.
Start with deterministic metrics to verify the task and dataset loop first.

title: Docs Or Assets Missing In Air-Gapped Deployments
summary: The docs portal is missing or incomplete because the image was built without the final static docs bundle.
symptoms: `/docs` serves an incomplete site or missing assets.
The runtime environment has no internet and cannot build docs on the fly.
checks: Verify the image build ran the docs generation and Docusaurus build steps.
Verify the final runtime image contains the built `docs_portal/build` output.
Verify the deployed reverse proxy preserves the docs route and asset paths.
fixes: Rebuild the image in a build-time environment with internet access if npm dependencies must be restored.
Redeploy the final image artifact rather than relying on repo-local docs build output.
